title: Re:I Was Able To Create the Strongest Skill in Another World, so I Decided To Be a Matchless Warrior ~ I’m the Only One Who Manipulates My Status ~
description:
Summoned to another world, Takumi awakens as a Hacker, someone with the power to manipulate the numerical values of stats. He is soon joined by Mia, another otherworlder; Carla, the demon princess; and Gale, Carla’s loyal bodyguard. Together, the four form a party.
After learning about the history and origins of this world in the Dwarf Kingdom, Takumi and his companions set their sights on their next destination: Zof, the royal capital of the demon realm. Their goal is to reach the Demon King himself. The war between demons and humans was orchestrated by the elves. To put an end to the conflict, the party now heads straight into demon territory.
The ultimate power fantasy of an otherworldly hacker returns with a fresh new start!
author: Uguisutoki Nijushichi
